concerns.text: Task T021 implements baseline execution 'locally with resource constraints' via multiprocessing, directly violating FR-004 and Plan 'Dual Resource Profile' which mandates the baseline run on 'Standard Resources' (separate job/runner) to measure the scalability gap. This silently relaxes the experimental design constraint.

Task T013 explicitly allows proceeding with the pipeline if rule coverage is <90% ('log... and proceed'), which semantically weakens FR-002's hard constraint that the system 'MUST... generate a rule library... where the rule set covers ≥90%'. This converts a blocking requirement into a warning.

Task T005a defines the annotation interface as a Streamlit app or manual JSONL entry but lacks the explicit 'blocking gate' and formal 'Cohen's Kappa validation' step required by Plan Phase 0 and Constitution Principle VI before distillation can begin. This risks unverified annotations entering the pipeline.

Task T029h implements a standard Paired t-test/Wilcoxon test on 'Time-to-Pivot' including censored values as fixed maximums. This violates SC-001 and Plan 'Complexity Tracking' which explicitly requires handling censored data via Tobit regression or survival analysis to avoid invalid statistical results.
